title: Luscious Russian Cabbage Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring white cabbage, now plant-based friendly, wrapped in lotus leaves and served with a rich deglaze fond.
instructions: Bring the mushroom broth to a boil and blanch the lotus leaves for 30 seconds to make them pliable.
In a large skillet, saute the shredded cabbage in vegan butter until it is caramelized and golden brown.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper to make the dumpling mixture.
Add the cooked cabbage to the dumpling mixture and stir until well combined.
Lay a blanched lotus leaf flat and place a tablespoon of the cabbage mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a triangle or square shape and repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
Steam the dumplings for 10 minutes or until they are cooked through and the filling is hot and gooey.
While the dumplings are steaming, deglaze the skillet with a little water to loosen the fond and serve it over the dumplings.
Serve the dumplings hot with the rich deglaze fond spooned over the top.
